career_ladder.note: Social Security Assistants (SSA) serve in the regional, sub-regional, and field offices of the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), a premier statutory social security organization under the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India. SSAs handle claim settlements, establishment compliance tracking, member accounts, and digital passbook administration under the EPF & MP Act, 1952.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Social Security Assistant in EPFO is conducted by NTA in two phases: Phase-I is an objective Computer Based Examination (CBT) carrying 600 marks with sectional timings; Phase-II is a qualifying Computer Data Entry / Skill Test in which candidates are shortlisted in the ratio of 1:10 of vacancies based on Phase-I merit.

financial_package.note: Compensation for Social Security Assistant (Group 'C', Non-Gazetted) in EPFO under 7th CPC central pay matrix.
financial_package.pay_source_label: 7th CPC Pay Matrix, Table 5 (Civilian Employees), Government of India
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated at Level 5 entry basic pay (₹29,200) with 58% Dearness Allowance across major regional office cities (X/Y/Z classifications); in-hand factors in standard 10% NPS Tier-I contribution and central employee deductions.
official_perks: House Rent Allowance (27%/18%/9% as per city tier) or leased accommodation facility
Transport Allowance with applicable Dearness Allowance
Comprehensive medical coverage under Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) / EPFO Medical Benefit Scheme
Productivity-linked annual bonus / festival advance entitlement
Defined contribution pension benefits under National Pension System (NPS) and leave travel concession (LTC)
